admissions.purpose: Canonical Heim-PC audio configuration, recording, playback, instruments and experimental music systems
admissions.truthAuthority: Systemkatalog owns stable product identity; heimgewebe/audio owns repository content and live audio tools own runtime observations.
operatingDependencies: physically connected audio and MIDI devices for live operation
admissions.maintenanceBurden: Keep product identity, repository entrypoints and donor boundaries aligned when audio or its hardware contracts change.
admissions.reviewOrRetirementPath: Review when the canonical audio repository changes; retire only after a replacement product and preserved donor provenance are evidenced.

admissions.purpose: read-only research tool for reproducible point-in-time analysis of public filings and deterministic shadow evaluation
admissions.truthAuthority: none: Alpha Lab owns its repository code and research artifacts but no ecosystem-wide truth domain.
operatingDependencies: explicitly approved public research sources for individual research runs
admissions.maintenanceBurden: Keep source-policy, reproducibility boundaries and the Systemkatalog purpose aligned when the research surface changes.
admissions.reviewOrRetirementPath: Review when the repository gains operational execution, changes its evidence boundary or ceases to provide a distinct reproducible research capability; retire the catalog node when the repository is archived or superseded.
